protocol: scripts/qwen38_eagle4_baseline.py --n-draft N --reps 3 --max-new-tokens 25; 10 mtpbench prompts, 25 greedy outputs, each arm vs its own back-to-back AR
purpose: Re-sweep n_draft after the graph-verify + device-projection optimizations changed the cost curve (the prior optimum was set pre-optimization).
conclusion: n_draft=2 remains optimal (1.31x AR, acc 0.650). Deeper drafts decline monotonically (n3 1.20x/0.556, n4 1.14x/0.501): the extra draft-step cost is not amortized because acceptance drops faster. No free n_draft win; the remaining draft lever is the ~39ms draft-chain cost (low-rank full-V head ~63MB/step; quantized drafter weights / hot-vocab head are candidates).
caveats: Throttled ZBook diagnostic; AR reference drifted 9.0->11.3 tok/s across runs, so cross-run absolute ratios are not comparable, but the within-sweep monotonic ordering is robust (each arm vs its own AR).
